blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Looking at yesterday helps us plan tomorrow. Last week had good moments. It also had busy ones.

Today we use was and were to tell that story. Monday was busy. The calls were long. The team was great.

Today we learn 5 useful words and we practise a lot. Take your time. Every sentence counts.

items.q: What helps us plan tomorrow?
items.why: "Looking at yesterday helps us plan tomorrow."

items.q: How were the calls?
items.why: "The calls were long."

items.q: The text says Monday was...
items.why: "Monday was busy."

items.q: The writer would most likely AGREE that...
options: the past has nothing to teach us
we can learn from last week
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que olhar para ontem ajuda a planejar — o passado ensina.

items.q: "Take your time. Every sentence counts." This suggests the lesson wants you to...
items.why: Inferência: "take your time" pede calma; cada frase importa, então vale praticar com cuidado.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emma falar da semana passada. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello. My name is Emma. Let me tell you about my last week here at Czarnikow.

Monday was very busy. I was at the office early. The morning calls were long, but they were good. My team was great. Everyone was ready.

Tuesday was easy. I was at home. I was on two calls, and they were short. The report was easy, so I was happy.

Wednesday was different. I was tired. Two days before, I was a little sick, so the day was slow. But my friends at work were kind. They were there for me.

On Thursday and Friday, we were in a big meeting. The room was full. The plans were clear. At the end, we were all happy with the results.

So, last week was busy, but it was a good week. Now I am ready for a new one. Thank you for listening.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How was Emma's Monday?
items.why: "Monday was very busy."

items.q: Where was Emma on Tuesday?
items.why: "Tuesday was easy. I was at home."

items.q: Why was Wednesday slow?
options: She was a little sick two days before
items.why: "Two days before, I was a little sick, so the day was slow."

items.q: Emma says her friends at work "were there for me." This suggests they were...
items.why: Inferência: "kind" e "there for me" mostram apoio.

items.q: How does Emma feel about last week overall?
items.why: Inferência: "last week was busy, but it was a good week."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I was at the office yesterday." Yesterday means...
items.why: Yesterday = ontem, o dia antes de hoje.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "___ week was great for the team."
items.why: Last week = a semana passada, que combina com "was".

items.q: "Two days ago, I was sick." Ago means...
items.why: Ago = atrás; "two days ago" = há dois dias.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Monday was ___. I had many calls and no free time."
items.why: Busy = ocupado; muitas ligações e sem tempo livre.

items.q: "The report was easy." Easy means...
items.why: Easy = fácil, não difícil.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "I was off on Friday." To be off means you were...
items.why: To be off = estar de folga, fora do trabalho.

items.q: "On Monday I caught up on my emails." To catch up on means to...
options: do work you were behind on
items.why: Catch up on = colocar em dia o que estava atrasado.

items.q: "The team signed off on the report." To sign off on means to...
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "The call was long, but we followed up by email." To follow up means to...
options: send a message after, to continue
items.why: Follow up = dar continuidade, retomar depois.

items.q: "On Tuesday I worked from home." This means you...
items.why: Work from home = trabalhar de casa.
